name: List All Community Association Homeowners
description: Returns Community Association (CA) homeowners that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the CA homeowner. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter CA homeowners by last updated date. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the CA homeowner

responseFields.name: data[].UnitId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit associated with the CA homeowner

responseFields.name: data[].AssociationId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the association associated with the CA homeowner

responseFields.name: data[].OccupancyId
responseFields.description: Unique Identifier of a CA occupancy of one or more CA homeowners

responseFields.name: data[].FirstName
responseFields.description: The first name of the CA homeowner

responseFields.name: data[].MiddleName
responseFields.description: The middle name of the CA homeowner

responseFields.name: data[].LastName
responseFields.description: The last name of the CA homeowner

responseFields.name: data[].PhoneNumber
responseFields.description: The CA homeowner's primary phone number

responseFields.name: data[].Status
responseFields.description: The status of the Community Association homeowner

responseFields.name: data[].Email
responseFields.description: The CA homeowner's primary email address

responseFields.name: data[].InCollections
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the CA Homeowner is in collections

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the CA homeowner's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].Link
responseFields.description: A link to the occupancy page of the homeowner

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
